description: GKEHubFleet is the Schema for the GKEHubFleet API

apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object. Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and may reject unrecognized values. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents. Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to. Cannot be updated. In CamelCase. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: GKEHubFleetSpec defines the desired state of GKEHubFleet

defaultClusterConfig.description: Optional. The default cluster configurations to apply across the fleet.

binaryAuthorizationConfig.description: Optional. Enable/Disable binary authorization features for the cluster.

evaluationMode.description: Optional. Mode of operation for binauthz policy evaluation.

policyBindingsRefs.description: Optional. Binauthz policies that apply to this cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed BinaryAuthorizationPlatformPolicy resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/platforms/{{platform}}/policies/{{policy}}".

name.description: The name of a BinaryAuthorizationPlatformPolicy resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a BinaryAuthorizationPlatformPolicy resource.

compliancePostureConfig.description: Optional. Enable/Disable Compliance Posture features for the cluster. Note that on UpdateFleet, only full replacement of this field is allowed. Users are not allowed for partial updates through field mask.

mode.description: Defines the enablement mode for Compliance Posture.

securityPostureConfig.description: Enable/Disable Security Posture features for the cluster.

mode.description: Sets which mode to use for Security Posture features.

vulnerabilityMode.description: Sets which mode to use for vulnerability scanning.

displayName.description:
Optional. A user-assigned display name of the Fleet.
When present, it must be between 4 to 30 characters.
Allowed characters are: lowercase and uppercase letters, numbers,
hyphen, single-quote, double-quote, space, and exclamation point.

Example: `Production Fleet`

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

resourceID.description: The GKEHubFleet name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

status.description: GKEHubFleetStatus defines the config connector machine state of GKEHubFleet

conditions.description: Conditions represent the latest available observations of the object's current state.

lastTransitionTime.description: Last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.

message.description: Human-readable message indicating details about last transition.

reason.description: Unique, one-word, CamelCase reason for the condition's last transition.

status.description: Status is the status of the condition. Can be True, False, Unknown.

type.description: Type is the type of the condition.

externalRef.description: A unique specifier for the GKEHubFleet resource in GCP.

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the generation of the resource that was most recently observed by the Config Connector controller. If this is equal to metadata.generation, then that means that the current reported status reflects the most recent desired state of the resource.

observedState.description: ObservedState is the state of the resource as most recently observed in GCP.

createTime.description: Output only. When the Fleet was created.

deleteTime.description: Output only. When the Fleet was deleted.

state.description: Output only. State of the namespace resource.

code.description: Output only. The current state of the Fleet resource.

uid.description: Output only. Google-generated UUID for this resource. This is unique across all Fleet resources. If a Fleet resource is deleted and another resource with the same name is created, it gets a different uid.

updateTime.description: Output only. When the Fleet was last updated.
